title: Google Home Token Hub
status_ok: Master Token is active and ready for Home Assistant.
tip_account: Configured Google email address associated with your Google Home devices.
tip_session_status: Current authentication state of the Google Master Token (aas_et/...).
tip_ha_interaction: Time elapsed since Home Assistant last queried this Token Hub.
tip_health: Operational status of the Token Hub and local speaker communication.
tip_master_token: Permanent master token generated from Google OAuth exchange.
step1_desc: Enter your Google Account Email and Password (or 16-character App Password) below.
step2_desc: The Token Hub securely authenticates with Google and extracts your Master Token (aas_et/...) automatically in the background.
step3_desc: Home Assistant automatically connects with the Token Hub and imports all your Google Home speakers and devices via ha-googlehome.
token_label: Manual Web OAuth Token (oauth2_4/...) or Master Token (aas_et/...)
auth_success: Master Token successfully generated and saved!
modal_2fa_intro: Google strictly blocks standard password logins when 2-Factor Authentication (2FA) is enabled on your Google account. Please use one of the following two easy methods:
modal_2fa_opt1_desc: Generate a dedicated 16-character App Password for Home Assistant in your Google Security settings and paste it into the password field above.
modal_2fa_opt2_desc: Sign in at accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup, confirm 2FA/Passkey, press F12 (Cookies) and paste the oauth_token under 'Advanced: Manual Token Entry'.
modal_logout_body: Are you sure you want to remove the stored Google Master Token? Home Assistant will lose device access until you reconnect.
prompt_number_desc: Google sent a security prompt. Select and tap the matching number on your phone:
prompt_code_desc: Enter the 6-digit security code received via SMS or Authenticator App:
val_email_invalid: Please enter a valid Google email address (e.g. name@gmail.com).
val_password_missing: Please enter your Google password or App Password.
val_token_invalid: Invalid token format. The token must start with 'aas_et/' (Master Token) or 'oauth2_4/' (Web OAuth Token).
findmy_desc: Generate tokens and E2EE decryption keys for the BSkando/GoogleFindMy-HA integration to track device locations.
tip_findmy_e2ee: End-to-End Encryption key (shared_key) required to decrypt real-time tracker locations.
findmy_step1_title: Step 1: Generate Find My ADM Token
findmy_step1_desc: Requires an active Master Token from the Google Home tab. Mints the Android Device Manager (ADM) token for Spot/Nova API queries.
findmy_step2_title: Step 2: Obtain E2EE Decryption Key (Shared Key)
findmy_step2_desc: Google encrypts GPS tracker coordinates end-to-end. Click below for instructions on retrieving your 64-character hex shared key via Google Domain Unlock or DevTools.
findmy_step2_note: 💡 Tip: The Google Unlock page must be opened in a browser where your Google Account is already signed in. If it loops or hangs on desktop, approve the screen lock on your Android phone or use DevTools Network tab to copy the key.
findmy_step3_desc: Automatically creates or updates secrets.json in /config/custom_components/googlefindmy/Auth/secrets.json.
alert_restart_desc: An integration was newly installed or updated. Please restart Home Assistant to load the component.
e2ee_modal_intro: Google encrypts Bluetooth tracker locations with End-to-End Encryption (E2EE). The key is secured by your Google Account's screen lock.
e2ee_step_1: Click the button below to open Google's official Domain Unlock page in a new tab.
e2ee_step_2: Sign in or confirm your Google Account screen lock / PIN / biometric prompt.
e2ee_step_3_desktop_desc: If Google loads indefinitely or shows #close at the end, your browser has already received the unlock payload. Check DevTools (Network tab for encryption/unlock response or copy from your Google Find My App / Python script) and paste the 64-char hex key into the Manual Key Import box.
e2ee_note_existing_secrets: If you already generated a secrets.json via BSkando/GoogleFindMy-HA or GoogleFindMyTools, you can simply paste the shared_key directly into the manual input field below without re-running this flow!
prompt_general_desc: Please tap 'Yes' on your smartphone or confirm the security prompt.
extracting_e2ee: Extracting E2EE Key via headless browser… (~30s)
findmy_step1_desc: Connect your Google Account to generate the required Android Device Manager (ADM) token for Spot/Nova tracker queries.
findmy_login_intro: 🔑 Connect your Google Account for Find My Device:
findmy_step2_desc: Google encrypts GPS tracker coordinates end-to-end. The add-on can extract this key automatically using the same headless browser session that generated your Master Token.
findmy_step2_auto_note: ✅ The add-on automatically navigates to the Google security domain unlock URL in its headless browser and captures the key — no DevTools or manual steps needed.
findmy_step2_note: 💡 Tip: Open the Google Unlock page in a browser where your Google Account is signed in. On desktop, if it hangs or shows #close, your browser already received the payload — copy the key from DevTools (Network → encryption/unlock) and paste below.
step_extract_init_desc: Starting clean browser instance in background...
step_extract_signing_in_desc: Bootstrapping Google session cookies via Master Token...
step_extract_navigating_desc: Navigating to Google security domain unlock URL...
step_extract_challenge_desc: Google requires password re-entry or screen-lock confirmation.
step_extract_success_desc: E2EE Shared Key captured and verified.
screenlock_modal_intro: Google protects your Find My Device encryption keys using the screen lock (PIN/pattern/fingerprint) of your Android device. Because this server has no physical display, Google requires you to authorize it on your registered phone or desktop browser.
